## Setup

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(here)
source(here("setup.R"))
source(here("functions", "data_cleaners.R"))
source(here("functions", "lfs_panel.R"))
source(here("functions", "construct_variables.R"))
```

## Prep Data
```{r}
panel06_26 <- build_residence_quarter_panel(
  here("data", "quarterly_lfs_raw"),
  from_year = 2006
)

panel06_26 %>% glimpse

panel06_26 <- read.csv("../data/processed/residence_quarter_panel_full.csv") %>% glimpse
```

## Construct Variables
```{r}
panel_file <- here("data", "processed", "residence_quarter_panel_full.csv")
if (!file.exists(panel_file)) {
  stop("Cannot find ", panel_file, ". Run pipeline/01_prep_data.R first.")
}

panel <- readr::read_csv(panel_file, show_col_types = FALSE)
vars <- construct_variables(panel)

vars %>% glimpse
```

## Main Regressions
```{r}
df <- read_csv("../data/processed/residence_quarter_regression.csv") %>% 
  filter(year>2021) %>%
  glimpse

```
```{r}
model1 <- feols(d_qoq_mean_log_hourpay_uk_born ~ d_qoq_mean_age_uk_born + d_qoq_share_uk_degree + d_qoq_share_uk_black| year |
                  d_qoq_ratio_migrant ~ d_qoq_national_ratio_migrant:baseline_ratio_migrant,
                data = df, vcov = ~residence
                )
etable(model1, stage = 1:2)
```

```{r}
model1 <- feols(d_qoq_mean_log_hourpay_uk_born ~ mean_age_uk_born + share_uk_degree + share_uk_black| year |
                  d_qoq_ratio_migrant ~ d_qoq_national_ratio_migrant:baseline_ratio_migrant,
                data = df, vcov = ~residence
                )
etable(model1, stage = 1:2)
```

## Quarterly regressions

Each chunk is one specification from `pipeline/04_main_regressions.R`. The sample is `year > 2015`. In the 2SLS chunks, `etable` prints both stages and the first-stage F and Wald tests (`ivf` and `ivwald`).

```{r quarterly-sample}
q_file <- here("data", "processed", "residence_quarter_regression.csv")
if (!file.exists(q_file)) {
  stop("Cannot find ", q_file, ". Run pipeline/02_construct_variables.R first.")
}
q_reg <- read_csv(q_file, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  filter(year > 2015) %>%
  filter(if_all(
    all_of(c(
      "d_qoq_mean_log_hourpay_uk_born", "residence", "period",
      "d_qoq_ratio_migrant", "shift_share_qoq_migrant",
      "d_qoq_ratio_eu", "d_qoq_ratio_non_eu",
      "shift_share_qoq_eu", "shift_share_qoq_non_eu",
      "d_qoq_share_uk_asian", "d_qoq_share_uk_black",
      "d_qoq_share_uk_chinese", "d_qoq_share_uk_eth_other",
      "d_qoq_share_uk_degree", "d_qoq_share_uk_low_qual",
      "d_qoq_mean_age_uk_born"
    )),
    ~ !is.na(.)
  ))
nrow(q_reg)
```

## Quarterly pooled

The endogenous variable is `d_qoq_ratio_migrant`. The instrument is `shift_share_qoq_migrant`.

### Step 0 OLS, no controls

```{r q-pool-ols-0}
model_q_pool_ols_0 <- feols(
  d_qoq_mean_log_hourpay_uk_born ~ d_qoq_ratio_migrant,
  data = q_reg,
  vcov = ~residence
)
etable(model_q_pool_ols_0)
```

### Step 0 2SLS, no controls

```{r q-pool-iv-0}
model_q_pool_iv_0 <- feols(
  d_qoq_mean_log_hourpay_uk_born ~ 1 |
    d_qoq_ratio_migrant ~ shift_share_qoq_migrant,
  data = q_reg,
  vcov = ~residence
)
etable(model_q_pool_iv_0, fitstat = ~ . + ivf + ivwald, stage = 1:2)
```

### Step 1 OLS, residence and quarter fixed effects

```{r q-pool-ols-1}
model_q_pool_ols_1 <- feols(
  d_qoq_mean_log_hourpay_uk_born ~ d_qoq_ratio_migrant | residence + period,
  data = q_reg,
  vcov = ~residence
)
etable(model_q_pool_ols_1)
```

### Step 1 2SLS, residence and quarter fixed effects

```{r q-pool-iv-1}
model_q_pool_iv_1 <- feols(
  d_qoq_mean_log_hourpay_uk_born ~ 1 |
    residence + period |
    d_qoq_ratio_migrant ~ shift_share_qoq_migrant,
  data = q_reg,
  vcov = ~residence
)
etable(model_q_pool_iv_1, fitstat = ~ . + ivf + ivwald, stage = 1:2)
```

### Step 2 OLS, fixed effects and ethnicity

```{r q-pool-ols-2}
model_q_pool_ols_2 <- feols(
  d_qoq_mean_log_hourpay_uk_born ~
    d_qoq_ratio_migrant +
    d_qoq_share_uk_asian + d_qoq_share_uk_black + d_qoq_share_uk_chinese + d_qoq_share_uk_eth_other |
    residence + period,
  data = q_reg,
  vcov = ~residence
)
etable(model_q_pool_ols_2)
```

## Annual regressions

Each chunk is one specification from `pipeline/04_main_regressions_annual.R`. The sample is `year > 2015` on complete calendar years. `period` is the calendar year. `d_annual_*_l1` is left out. In the 2SLS chunks, `etable` prints both stages and the first-stage F and Wald tests (`ivf` and `ivwald`).

```{r annual-sample}
a_file <- here("data", "processed", "residence_annual_regression.csv")
if (!file.exists(a_file)) {
  stop(
    "Cannot find ", a_file,
    ". Run pipeline/02_construct_annual_variables.R first."
  )
}
a_reg <- read_csv(a_file, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  filter(year > 2015) %>%
  filter(if_all(
    all_of(c(
      "d_annual_mean_log_hourpay_uk_born", "residence", "year", "period",
      "d_annual_ratio_migrant", "shift_share_annual_migrant",
      "d_annual_ratio_eu", "d_annual_ratio_non_eu",
      "shift_share_annual_eu", "shift_share_annual_non_eu",
      "d_annual_share_uk_asian", "d_annual_share_uk_black",
      "d_annual_share_uk_chinese", "d_annual_share_uk_eth_other",
      "d_annual_share_uk_degree", "d_annual_share_uk_low_qual",
      "d_annual_mean_age_uk_born"
    )),
    ~ !is.na(.)
  )) %>%
  mutate(
    residence = as.character(residence),
    period = as.character(year)
  )
nrow(a_reg)
```

```{r a-eu-iv-2}
    d_annual_share_uk_asian + d_annual_share_uk_black + d_annual_share_uk_chinese + d_annual_share_uk_eth_other |
    residence + period |
    d_annual_ratio_eu + d_annual_ratio_non_eu ~ shift_share_annual_eu + shift_share_annual_non_eu,
  data = a_reg,
  vcov = ~residence
)
etable(model_a_eu_iv_2, fitstat = ~ . + ivf + ivwald, stage = 1:2)
```
